01

“Do not put [yourselves] before God and His Messenger”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Do not put [yourselves] before God and His Messenger [al-Hujurat 1] he said: He says: "do not act presumptuously toward the Messenger of God ﷺ in anything until God, Mighty and Majestic, decrees it through his tongue."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ [الحجرات: 1] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: لَا تَفْتَاتُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِشَيْءٍ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَهُ اللَّهُ عز وجل عَلَى لِسَانِهِ "
Edition record 373384 · p. 610Link to report ↗
02

“and do not be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:2).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and do not be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others [al-Hujurat 2] He says: "do not call him by his name as a call, but speak gently: 'O Messenger of God.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ [الحجرات: 2] يَقُولُ: " لَا تُنَادُوهُ بِاسْمِهِ نِدَاءً، وَلَكِنْ قُولُوا قَوْلًا لَيِّنًا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ "
Edition record 373385 · p. 610Link to report ↗
03

“Those are the ones whose hearts God has tested for righteousness”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:3).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Those are the ones whose hearts God has tested for righteousness [al-Hujurat 3] He says: "God has purified their hearts."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَى [الحجرات: 3] يَقُولُ: «أَخْلَصَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ»
Edition record 373386 · p. 610Link to report ↗

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:4).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحُجُرَاتِ [الحجرات: 4] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي أَعْرَابًا مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ»

05

“If there comes to you a defiantly disobedient one with information…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:6).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, he said:
"The Messenger of God ﷺ sent al-Walid ibn Uqba ibn Abi Muayt to the Banu ⦗p. 611⦘ al-Mustaliq to collect their alms; they met him with gifts. He returned to the Messenger of God ﷺ and said: 'The Banu al-Mustaliq have gathered to fight you.'" So God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: If there comes to you a defiantly disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful [al-Hujurat 6].
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ:
" أَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ إِلَى بَنِي ⦗ص: 611⦘ الْمُصْطَلِقِ لِيُصَدِّقَهُمْ فَتَلَقَّوْهُ بِالْهَدِيَّةِ، فَرَجَعَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ بَنِي الْمُصْطَلِقِ جَمَعُوا لَكَ لِيُقَاتِلُونَكَ " فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل إِنْ جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَأٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَنْ تُصِيبُوا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ [الحجرات: 6]
Edition record 373388 · p. 610Link to report ↗
06

“And if two groups among the believers fight each other”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:9).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And if two groups among the believers fight each other [al-Hujurat 9] he said: "meaning the Aws and the Khazraj, who fought among themselves with sticks."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَإِنْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا [الحجرات: 9] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الْأَوْسَ وَالْخَزْرَجَ اقْتَتَلُوا بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْعِصِيِّ»
Edition record 373389 · p. 611Link to report ↗
07

“Let not a people ridicule [another] people”

Three explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:11).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Let not a people ridicule [another] people [al-Hujurat 11]: "let not one people mock another; He says: whether a man is rich or poor, if another is preferred over him in something, he should not be mocked for it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِنْ قَوْمٍ [الحجرات: 11] " لَا يَسْتَهْزِئْ قَوْمٌ بِقَوْمٍ، يَقُولُ: إِنْ يَكُنْ رَجُلًا غَنِيًّا أَوْ فَقِيرًا، أَنْ يَفْضُلَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ بِشَيْءٍ لَا يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِ "
Edition record 373390 · p. 611Link to report ↗
08
Explanation from Mujāhid 08

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames [al-Hujurat 11] He says: "do not slander one another."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَا تَلْمِزُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا بِالْأَلْقَابِ [الحجرات: 11] يَقُولُ: «لَا يَطْعَنْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ»
Edition record 373391 · p. 611Link to report ↗
09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames [al-Hujurat 11] He says: "a Muslim is not to be called a disbeliever after Islam." God, Mighty and Majestic, says: How wretched is the name of defiance [fusuq] [al-Hujurat 11], this, after belief [al-Hujurat 11]. Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, who said: "It is a man's saying to his brother: 'O wicked one.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا بِالْأَلْقَابِ [الحجرات: 11] يَقُولُ: «لَا يَدَّعِي الْمُسْلِمُ بِالْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ الْإِسْلَامِ» ، يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عز وجل بِئْسَ الِاسْمُ الْفُسُوقُ [الحجرات: 11] هَذَا بَعْدَ الْإِيمَانِ [الحجرات: 11] . أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: " هُوَ قَوْلُ الرَّجُلِ لِأَخِيهِ: يَا فَاسِقُ "
Edition record 373392 · p. 611Link to report ↗
08

“Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead?”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:12).

10
Explanation from Mujāhid 10

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
When Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? [al-Hujurat 12] was revealed, they said: "We dislike that." He said: "Then fear God regarding backbiting."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ:
أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا [الحجرات: 12] قَالُوا: " نَكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ فِي الْغِيبَةِ "
Edition record 373393 · p. 612Link to report ↗
11
Report from Mujāhid 11

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, he said:
"The shuub are the distant lineage, and the qabail are what is below that. He says: We made this so you may know that So-and-so son of So-and-so is from such-and-such."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الشُّعُوبُ: النَّسَبُ الْبَعِيدُ، وَالْقَبَائِلُ: دُونَ ذَلِكَ، يَقُولُ: جَعَلْنَا هَذَا لِتَعْرِفُوا فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا "
Edition record 373394 · p. 612Link to report ↗
09

“The Bedouins say, 'We have believed'”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:14).

12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
The Bedouins say, 'We have believed' [al-Hujurat 14] he said: "This verse was revealed about the Bedouins of Asad ibn Khuzayma."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ آمَنَّا [الحجرات: 14] قَالَ: «نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ فِي أَعْرَابِ أَسَدِ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ»
Edition record 373395 · p. 612Link to report ↗

Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
